title: Gabapentin and Chronic Post Surgical Pain
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to investigate the effect of a common pain medication (gabapentin) on chronic postsurgical pain in pediatric patients who require surgery for idiopathic scoliosis.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Be aged 10-18 years at the time of surgery
* Have a diagnosis of idiopathic scoliosis and/or kyphosis
* Be undergoing elective posterior spinal fusion
* Have only mild systemic disease

Exclusion Criteria:

* A diagnosis of neuromuscular scoliosis and/or kyphosis
* A diagnosis of chronic pain
* Used opioids in the past 6 months
* Developmental delay
* Liver or kidney disease
* Obstructive sleep apnea
* Body mass index \>40
* Be pregnant or breastfeeding
